statement: Native Debian ARM64 Dolphin 2503, motionplus-nunchuk, with an empty default EEPROM, enumerates the virtual Remote through HIDAPI and adds its ControllerInterface device according to its own notice log. Repeated base accelerometer calibration failures are the first protocol blocker. Mapping UI and decoded motion are unobserved; raw reports and device addition are not decoded gyro acceptance. No physical compatibility or radio operation is inferred.

applicability.revision: Original virtual model; physical revision unmeasured
applicability.scope: evidence_role: consumer. Bounded virtual UHID observation with caller-image choice explicit. No decoded application-state, physical, radio, game, timing or whole-controller acceptance promotion.
